name: Mamba-7B
description:
Here is how to read the Mamba-7B config.json. The architecture class is MambaForCausalLM, which is the transformers (or equivalent) module that wires embeddings, attention, the MLP, and the language-modelling head that turns hidden states into next-token logits.

hidden_size is 4,096: that is the width of every residual stream vector. The embedding matrix is therefore 50,432 × 4,096: each token id owns a vector of that width.

num_hidden_layers is 64: the stack is that many transformer blocks deep.

intermediate_size is 8,192. In a SwiGLU MLP this is the high-dimensional workspace: the 4,096-wide stream is projected up, activated with silu, then projected back. Labs usually round this width to a multiple of 128 or 256 so it tiles on the chip.

vocab_size is 50,432. 50,432 is divisible by 256, the usual vocab-tiling grain. bos/eos ids, when present, are just two special rows in that table; the padded vocab is often larger than the tokenizer’s real inventory.

torch_dtype is float32.

The copy of config.json is from https://huggingface.co/tri-ml/mamba-7b-rw/blob/main/config.json.
